files.help:
Extensions can be moved using `--extensions-dir "$XDG_DATA_HOME/positron/extensions"` in a wrapper script and updating your `.desktop` file.

However, `argv.json` and `cli/` are still hardcoded here.

_Relevant issues:_ https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/162712 , https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/3884

Can be moved by passing `--shared-data-dir "$XDG_STATE_HOME/positron-shared"` in a wrapper script and updating your `.desktop` file.

Requested to become the default upstream:

_Relevant issues:_ https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/330061 , https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/3884

Created on remote hosts. Relocatable only for Remote-SSH via the client's `settings.json`:

```json
"remote.SSH.serverInstallPath": {
  "my-host": "$HOME/.local/share/positron-server"
}
```

Global SSH defaults are unsupported.

_Relevant issue:_ https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/3884
